messages:
incident-bot: Pager — Auth probe detected: ~12k failed logins/min and 2.3k requests/min to /v1/prompt/generate from a small set of IPs (13.52.1.0/24). Possible credential stuffing + prompt scraping. Auto-rate-slice triggered.
iris: ACK. Jumping in. Is this across regions?
dan: Mostly eu-west and us-east from that IP block. I'm seeing short-lived bursts with many unique tokens.
saurabh: Looks like a scraper fanout using stolen API keys — tokens with low historical usage. WAF signatures not matching yet.
ops: Applying temporary per-token quota: set token_quota_cut=0.2 for tokens with <100 calls/day via config service. Command:
```
POST /admin/quotas/cut
{ "matcher": "token.hist_calls_lt:100", "multiplier": 0.2 }
```
iris: Good. Also rolling back feature flag to reduce fanout: disabling prompt-multistream->off in prod.
```
rdwctl flags set prompt-multistream=false --env=prod
```
dan: Pushing WAF rule to edge to tag and tarpit that CIDR, not outright block so we can trace: rule -> tag=maybe-scraper, action=tarpit
deploy-bot: WAF rule deployed to edges in eu-west/us-east (rule 2026-07-scraper-tag)
support-bot: Notifying top 10 affected customers in EU about transient rate shaping; drafting copy, cc: maya
maya: I'll send the customer note with mitigations and expected timeframe (1-2 hours). Putting a banner in status page.
iris: Rolling out a faster fallback model for tiered routing so small tokens get cheaper short-circuit model (reduces backend load): rolled canary 5% -> 50% in 20m.
ops: Added temporary stricter request size limit to /v1/prompt/generate: max_tokens=4096 -> 2048 for untrusted tokens.
saurabh: KV cache hit rate fell, so we expect higher compute per token, but overall request reduction looks good.
iris: Traffic down ~68% from peak after quota cut + feature flag + WAF tag. Error rate normalizing. Keeping tarpit + quota policy for now.
dan: Any need for IP blacklisting vs tarpit? We should keep tarpit to observe credential patterns for forensics.
iris: Agreed. No outright block unless we see clear malicious pivot. Assigning postmortem: @dan + @saurabh + @iris. Ops to retain logs for 90 days.
support-bot: Customer comms sent to impacted accounts. Status page updated.
iris: Oncall handing off in 30m to night team; leaving runbook steps in incident doc: runbook link <https://intranet/redwood/incidents/1718604321>. If anything regresses, page pager.
ops: Monitoring dashboards: token_fail_rate, edge_rate_by_cidr, kw:maybe-scraper tag. Alerts lowered to 1m aggregation.
iris: Thanks team. I'll start the postmortem skeleton and link logs. Closing slack thread unless we get new pages.
